subject: Quickstart Grant Request — Holoworks POC Intake
messages:
From: Miriam Park <miriam@holoworks.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T15:03:00Z
Subject: Quickstart Promo Credit Request — Holoworks POC

Hi Naomi,

We just completed the self-serve signup for Holoworks (org: holoworks.ai) and ran a few smoke tests — the model looks promising. We're a small ML tools team and want to run a 2-week POC to validate latency and cost for a real-time assistant. Can you help with a short promo grant to cover ~150k tokens of inference so we can run realistic traffic?

Quick details:
- Primary contact: Miriam Park, Head of ML (miriam@holoworks.ai)
- Team size for POC: 3 engineers, 1 PM
- Use case: real-time code-assist in-browser 
- Preferred region: us-west (for latency)

Attached is the completed signup intake form. We're looking for expedited review — can you confirm what information you need and an ETA for approval?

Thanks,
Miriam

--
Miriam Park
Head of ML, HoloWorks Inc
miriam@holoworks.ai
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miriam Park <miriam@holoworks.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-19T16:20:00Z
Subject: Re: Quickstart Promo Credit Request — Holoworks POC

Hi Miriam — welcome and thanks for the details. I see the intake form attached and that helps a lot. A couple quick clarifying questions so I can route this for approval:

- Which environment did you create (playground vs org project)? If org, can you share the Organization ID or the sign-up email domain confirmation?
- Expected daily token volume during the 2-week POC (ballpark is fine).
- Any regulatory or data residency requirements beyond US?

If you prefer, I can loop in our CS engineer for a short kickoff to help configure batching and KV caching to keep costs down.

Ben — passing to you for promo approval once Miriam confirms the Org ID and expected usage.

Thanks,
Naomi

--
Naomi Feldman
Sales Director, Redwood Inference
naomi@redwoodinference.com
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwoodinference.com>
To: Miriam Park <miriam@holoworks.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T09:35:00Z
Subject: Re: Quickstart Promo Credit Request — Holoworks POC

Hi Miriam — thanks for the intake and Naomi for the triage. Based on the use case and small team size, I'm comfortable approving a provisional 150,000 token promo credit for a 30-day window to cover the POC.

Terms / next steps (summary):
- Credit amount: 150k tokens, expires 30 days after issuance
- Applied to Org ID: HLW-2026-041 (please confirm if that matches your org view)
- Monitoring: we'll activate basic cost alerts on your account and follow up if usage patterns indicate broader rollout needs

Attached: promo_credit_terms.pdf (standard PLG promo terms). Miriam, please reply with the org ID to confirm and I'll ask Operations to apply the credit.

Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwoodinference.com

Miriam — thanks for confirming the Org ID (HLW-2026-041). I've just applied the 150k promo credit to your org; you should see it in the Console under Billing -> Credits: https://app.redwoodinference.com/orgs/holoworks/credits

What I did:
- Applied 150,000 token promo credit (expires 2026-12-22)
- Enabled a basic cost alert at 60% usage and set notification to your signup email

Next steps:
- If you'd like, book a 30-minute setup call here: https://calendly.com/redwood-onsite/intro (we can walk through batching, caching, and a recommended prompt set for realistic latency testing)
- If usage will exceed 150k during the POC, reply and we'll escalate for an additional short-term top-up.

Enjoy the POC — let us know if anything breaks or you want a short walkthrough.

Best,
